variants.name: 残りの列だけ・売った記録の全て・式で直す

read: SELECT remaining FROM tickets WHERE id = 1
fix: UPDATE tickets SET remaining = 5 - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales) WHERE id = 1;
sell: BEGIN TRANSACTION; UPDATE tickets SET remaining = remaining - 1 WHERE id = 1; INSERT INTO sales (counter, sold_at) VALUES ('窓口1', '10:30:00'); COMMIT;
BEGIN TRANSACTION; UPDATE tickets SET remaining = remaining - 1 WHERE id = 1; INSERT INTO sales (counter, sold_at) VALUES ('窓口2', '10:30:01'); COMMIT;

variants.name: 小文字で書く・記録を先に足して END で閉じる

read: select count(*) as sold from sales;
fix: update tickets set remaining = 3 where id = 1;
sell: BEGIN; INSERT INTO sales (counter, sold_at) VALUES ('窓口1', '10:30:00'); UPDATE tickets SET remaining = remaining - 1 WHERE id = 1; END;
BEGIN; INSERT INTO sales (counter, sold_at) VALUES ('窓口2', '10:30:00'); UPDATE tickets SET remaining = remaining - 1 WHERE id = 1; END;
SELECT * FROM tickets; SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales;

wrong.why: 表の名前を打ち間違える
